While cases can be argued for a few of the others, the safest option seems to be LADY CARO (nap) who has been a rising force since upped to 3m at this track and won easily last time out. The revised weights make it much more difficult in theory but she is still preferred to Miss Tiara who was third to her in that race. Border Gem, upped in trip, is third on the list, given that Hurst Hill has not been seen in recent action.[Richard Austen] Page 2 spotlighttaunton 22.04.26

The leaders of that pack could be Midnight Pass and Myrighthandman (preferred in that order) but it's tempting to side with DIRTY DEN, who contested a couple of fiercely competitive handicaps on his last two starts and can be expected to do better this time.[Richard Russell] Page 3 spotlighttaunton 22.04.26

With Old Bridge (second choice) coming back in trip, Little Lady Lucy is unlikely to get the same uncontested lead she enjoyed at Wincanton last time, though she still commands respect under her penalty. However, with a strong pace likely, DARING TO DREAM could be the one to benefit, having shaped with encouragement at Stratford last time and looking open to further improvement.
